free_tier.stated: 20,000 files per Worker version on Free; 25 MiB per file; 100 Workers per account => ~488 GiB per Worker, ~48.8 TiB per free account. 'There is no additional cost for storing Assets.'
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: 'Requests to static assets are free and unlimited'. Workers Static Assets billing doc. Only Worker-script invocations (SSR) count against the 100,000/day free request quota.

tooling: wrangler deploy with an assets binding (wrangler 3.78.10+); Workers REST API; static assets can be deployed with no Worker script logic, so serving is purely static.
chaining: 100 Workers on the free plan x 100,000 files (paid) or 20,000 files (free) x 25 MiB. Separate bucket from Pages on the same account, so a single free account presents Pages (100x20k) + Workers (100x20k) file slots. Unlimited accounts multiply further.
limits_note: 20,000 files and 100 Workers on Free; 25 MiB per file; must stay under the Worker *request* quota only if a script runs (run_worker_first / SSR). Static-only assets do not count against that quota at all.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: Free-tier 429s apply to script-invoking routes only; purely static paths keep serving. No eviction window documented for assets. They live as long as the Worker version.
